title: the Ninefold Court Rising Again
author: Lena Marchetti
blurb: Rafael Blackwood, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
